'They happen about every year, his last one was on Christmas day 2009' (only ~6 months before the letter) is the classic last-reported-event ambiguity: reasonably read as ongoing active-rate (model's reading) or as newly seizure-free (gold's reading).

Generic 'his seizures are also well controlled' merely restates what the model already captured via its two specific per-type seizure-free predictions (FBTC last 2015, FSAA last 2017); redundant generic gold tag.

Gold duplicate-tags the same 'seizures have stopped...last seizure now was 5 months ago' fact twice (once per supporting sentence); model's single seizure-free prediction covers it.

Model consolidated the header 'Infrequent focal seizures' descriptor and the body's 'no further seizures' into one correctly-CUI'd seizure-free tag; gold's separate generic 'seizures' seizure-free entry is a redundant restatement of the same currently-resolved fact.

'The absences continue fairly frequent, he probably gets 2-3 per day' is one statement gold redundantly double-tags as both active-rate and changed/Frequent; model's single active-rate absences prediction already conveys the substance.
